title: Shared Open Worlds for Human–AI Dyads: Role Switching, Experience Qualification, and Cross-World Continuity Evaluation
author: Ivan Kotov
evidence_boundary: Conceptual and methodological preprint. No empirical experiment, runtime implementation, independently annotated benchmark, identity-continuity result or economic superiority is reported. English v0.2 has not undergone separate independent peer review. A separate C/B1 comparison is not planned before an actual treatment is specified.
